clips.title: The story
paras: At Fire Scar Shrine, Ilkrud Magthrull's Tome draws Delgren the Purifier's attention. Its pages connect the warlock to the cultists at the Tower of Althalaxx.

Ilkrud Magthrull holds the Fire Scar Shrine in southwestern Ashenvale, where demonic influence has poisoned the site. The formidable orc warlock is surrounded by summoned minions. His personal tome records foul rituals and shadowy communications. The Argent Dawn paladin Delgren the Purifier has long known of Magthrull's presence, but the ties between the warlock and the dark cultists gathering at the Tower of Althalaxx make the book urgent to recover.
